---
title: "Day 2 – Tools and the reproduction"
---
Day 2 is the day of the tools. It teaches R and the IDE on the data of the case, builds the analysis file from the raw files, and ends with a reproduction: each participant chooses one of the five reanalyses and reproduces the value that Multi100 recorded for it, with time to understand every line of the code that produced it. The five analysts built their data from the same raw files, each in their own way: two on country-years, one on country-wave cells and two on the respondents themselves. Each participant reproduces the value that Multi100 recorded for one of them, from the raw waves and the code that the analyst deposited.

| Session | What happens | Material |
|---|---|---|
| 1 – R and the IDE | Objects, data frames, the pipe, reading files and looking at them, in the IDE that you installed on day 1. | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd), [your IDE](../../companion/ide.qmd) |
| 2 – From the raw files to the analysis file | Data management on the raw files: the country-year panel of the paper, aggregated from the respondents of the Eurobarometer waves, with the scales of EU framing built from the items that each respondent mentioned. | [Data management](../../companion/data-management.qmd) |
| 3 – The reproduction | The five reanalyses and the choices that separate them; the reproduction of one of them, chosen by each participant, read line by line. | [The five reanalyses on the case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-reanalysts), [the exercise overview](../../cases/eu-frames/exercise.qmd), Task 3 of the workspace |
| 4 – The report | The reproduced value written up in the Quarto report of the workspace, with a short statement of what was reproduced and how, and sent to the class. | [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) |

**By the end of the day** you can find your way around R and the IDE, you have built the analysis file of the case from the raw data, and you have reproduced one recorded result and written down how.
